text:
Sam Green: Noticed a small under-reporting on invoices for 2026-05-02. Totals ~9.2k tokens undercounted across 2 customers. Looks like an SQS visibility/worker handshake issue during a deploy.

Harini Rao: Ugh. Can you share the quick diagnostic and affected orgs?

Sam Green: Query I ran:
```sql
SELECT org_id, SUM(tokens_expected)-SUM(tokens_ingested) AS gap
FROM token_ingest_summary
WHERE day = '2026-05-02'
GROUP BY org_id
HAVING gap > 0;
```
Results (sanitized): org-210 gap=5400, org-399 gap=3800 -> total 9200.

metering-bot: alert: sqs-visibility-failures metric=visibility_timeout_spikes value=7 window=1h source=ingest-workers

Luca Moretti: I can own the replay/backfill. Hypothesis: worker picked messages but failed to ack before visibility timeout during a brief deployment, leaving messages unprocessed. Short-term: requeue window and run backfill. Long-term: increase visibility timeout and add pre-deploy drain.

Harini Rao: Proposed action items (owners + ETA):
- [x] Evidence capture and org list (Sam) - ticket FIN-8123 - done
- [ ] Requeue missing window + replay (Luca) - cmd/run-id pending - ETA 2026-05-03 04:00Z
- [ ] Ledger backfill job (Luca) - job-id after replay - ETA after verification
- [ ] Draft credit memos & legal review (Harini + Legal) - ETA 2026-05-03 EOD
- [ ] Postmortem + recurrence mitigations (Luca) - draft by 2026-05-07

Sam Green: Dry-run replay command I'm about to run:
```bash
./sqs-replay --queue tokens-prod --from 2026-05-02T00:00:00Z --to 2026-05-03T00:00:00Z --dry-run
```

Luca Moretti: Dry-run output: events_to_replay=9400 projected_gap=9200 projected_time=10m. Starting real replay now. job-id=sqs-replay-1284.

billing-bot: INFO: invoice-reissue queued for affected accounts pending ledger fix (job=inv-reissue-9012)

Harini Rao: Please provide USD credit amounts in the draft. Use $0.00034/token for conversion. Also loop in CSMs for potential outreach.

Luca Moretti: Replay finished; ledger-backfill scheduled job-id=ledger-backfill-992. Verification sample uploaded to internal drive (link: https://redwood.internal/repairs/ledger-backfill-992).

Sam Green: Posted verification sample snippet: org-210 before=120300 after=125700 delta=5400; org-399 before=87400 after=91200 delta=3800.

Harini Rao: Draft customer message (short): "We detected an internal processing delay that underreported your usage on May 2. We've corrected your ledger and applied a credit of $X. Apologies for the inconvenience; contact billing@redwood.com with questions." Legal suggests saying "processing delay" and include USD credit.

Luca Moretti: Postmortem owner: Luca Moretti. Planned mitigations: pre-deploy drain hook for ingest workers, increase default SQS visibility timeout to 120s, add a daily ledger parity check, and add a replay-dryrun smoke test to CI. Will file PRs and link them in the postmortem.

billing-bot: INFO: invoice-reissue inv-reissue-9012 resumed and completed. credits_applied=true.

Harini Rao: Confirmed credits posted. Closing this thread for finance follow-ups. Luca to publish postmortem and closure checklist by 2026-05-07.

Sam Green: Thanks all.
